comments.author: @somename5632
comments.text:
People in the comments have this weird view that this will somehow empower people to create their own movies, games, etc. The reality is that in the long run AI will not only be able to create clips based on a prompt, but also will create whole movies based on the taste of the consumer. So instead of streaming a movie or series on Netflix, we will go online to an AI-Streaming service and the AI will present us custom series and films unique to our taste. Some movies may still have a human mind behind it sure, but most will be generated by AI tailored to the taste of the consumer.

This is probably the end of human storytelling.
